_comment: Reset pose: the arm raised and reaching out over the table, ready to be driven.
Teleop walks here at start-up and on the A button.
THIS IS A SIM DEFAULT, not a measured pose. It puts the grasp_site at about
(0.35, 0.00, 0.30) m in the arm's base frame, with at least 0.57 rad of margin
on every joint, which is enough for IK to move freely in all directions.
Before driving a real arm, re-record it for your own table: bring the arm up in
gravity compensation, hand-guide it to a comfortable ready pose, and copy the
joint readout here. See the README.
Do NOT set this to all zeros: the YAM's j2 and j3 lower limits are exactly 0.0,
so a zeros pose sits on two joint limits and IK pins immediately.
_comment_verified: Set this to true once you have recorded this pose on the real arm and
confirmed the arm can reach it without hitting the table or a fixture.
Until then the i2rt backend refuses to start, because homing is a 3 s move
the operator cannot interrupt with the clutch.
